Definition: neuter of a derivative of G2462; the cavalry force:--horse(-men).
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, hippikón means horse. It occurs just once, in Revelation.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple here: hippikón means horse, and I do not stretch it further.
